data.title: Anthropic Says It’s Taking Claude Fable 5 Offline to Comply With US Government Order

content.basic: “The government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or ‘jailbreaking’ Fable 5,” the company said in a blog post.

data.title: Anthropic’s safety warnings may have just backfired — the government has pulled the plug on its most powerful AI

content.basic: Anthropic isn't hiding its frustration. "We disagree that the finding of a narrow potential jailbreak should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people," the company wrote in a blog post.
